findings.text: program_key_entry_count is a second program-key counter: the capability is owned by scripts/h200_test_lane/cache_reuse_summary.py:63 served_keys, which the plan's owner note and counter-reconciliation note both require this node to extend, and the addition duplicates rather than extends it, leaving cache_reuse_summary.py:115 reporting len(served_keys) under the same served_entries name with a definition that counts -atime companions and any non-suffixed file, so the two counters disagree on one directory and the plan's one-counter post-condition is false.

the added row passes pytest as the command, so prewarm_row.py:88 propagates pytest's exit status, and the lane target fails three tests at this revision (3 failed, 27 passed in arm-prewarm.log:344, arm-warm.log:282 and arm-old-pin.log:350), which makes every full pre-warm run exit nonzero for test content unrelated to the cache; the arms recorded ARMS_PREWARM_STATUS=0 only because they invoked prewarm_row.py with the test path, whose module-level if __name__ == '__main__' discards pytest.main's return value, so the measured exit contradicts the production path.

no assertion covers the plan's counter reconciliation, which requires a test that the guard, the pre-warm payload and the summary report the same count on one fixture layout, so nothing reddens when the three sites drift apart.

test_served_directory_reports_program_key_entries calls jax.config.update without restoring the previous value, leaving the session's compilation cache directory pointing at a tmp_path pytest deletes afterwards, so any later test in the same process that reads the cache configuration sees a vanished directory.

the file is not ruff-format clean: ruff format would collapse the marker_lines comprehension and the final assert onto single lines and the file has no trailing newline, so a path-scoped formatter run on this file rewrites it.
